# MesoViewSpec: reference, MesoQL symbols

The symbols a MesoQL address is made of. What an address means is in [mesoql.md](../mesoql.md). A `…` marks arguments
that take the rest, `?` an optional one, `:name` a keyword.

| Symbol       | Full name          | Returns   | Arguments                                                | Keywords                                | Meaning                                                                                                             | Example                                                                     |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `all`        | `meso.all`         | selection |                                                          |                                         | every copy in the scene                                                                                             | `(all)`                                                                     |
| `population` | `meso.population`  | selection | `ids…` (population)                                      |                                         | the copies of populations                                                                                           | `(population p.catalase)`                                                   |
| `instance`   | `meso.instance`    | selection | `ids…` (instance)                                        |                                         | copies stated individually, by id: the same copy across re-resolutions (unlike `copies`)                            | `(instance i.granule-a)`                                                    |
| `entity`     | `meso.entity`      | selection | `ids…` (entity)                                          |                                         | the copies of every population of these entities                                                                    | `(entity e.catalase)`                                                       |
| `in`         | `meso.compartment` | selection | `ids…` (compartment)                                     | `:nested` (bool), `:location` (word)    | the copies of the populations of compartments (and of the compartments inside them, unless :nested false)           | `(in c.exosome :location membrane)`                                         |
| `model`      | `meso.model`       | selection | `ids…` (model)                                           |                                         | the copies a model placed                                                                                           | `(model m.picks)`                                                           |
| `copies`     | `meso.copies`      | selection | `population` (population), `start` (int), `count?` (int) |                                         | copies of one population by ordinal: from `start`, `count` of them (default 1); valid for one resolution            | `(copies p.catalase 12)`                                                    |
| `and`        | `meso.and`         | selection | `operands…` (selection)                                  |                                         | copies in every operand                                                                                             | `(and (entity e.catalase) (in c.exosome))`                                  |
| `or`         | `meso.or`          | selection | `operands…` (selection)                                  |                                         | copies in any operand                                                                                               | `(or (population p.CD9) (population p.CD63))`                               |
| `not`        | `meso.not`         | selection | `operand` (selection)                                    | `:in` (selection)                       | copies not in the operand (within :in, default every copy)                                                          | `(not (entity e.lipid))`                                                    |
| `within`     | `meso.within`      | selection | `operand` (selection)                                    | `:of` (selection), `:distance` (length) | copies of the first selection whose centre is within :distance of a copy of :of (centres, the document length unit) | `(within (entity e.ALB) :of (population p.catalase.observed) :distance 20)` |
| `site`       | `meso.site`        | site      | `entity` (entity), `site` (word)                         |                                         | a named site of an entity (its `sites`): a point and an axis in the entity's frame, one per copy                    | `(site e.hu dna-entry)`                                                     |
| `residues`   | `meso.residues`    | residues  | `entity` (entity)                                        | `:chain` (word), `:range` (range)       | residues of an entity's structure, by chain and label range (a schematized address: needs the structure loaded)     | `(residues e.hu :chain A :range 53-63)`                                     |
| `part`       | `meso.part`        | selection | `instances` (selection), `inner` (population)            |                                         | copies of an inner population of a superstructure, in the instances the first selection picks                       | `(part (copies p.granules 12) p.Vamp2)`                                     |
